summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Barclays Commercial Mortgage Securities LLC, as depositor for BBCMS Mortgage Trust 2019-C3, reporting a change in special servicer for the Christiana Mall Mortgage Loan (1.0% of the asset pool). The filing states that Trimont LLC was removed as special servicer under the BBCMS 2018-CHRS TSA and Green Loan Services LLC was appointed as successor special servicer, effective July 14, 2026. There are no transaction terms, deal values, or special-situation elements. This is an operational servicing update, not a special situation.
